thread:
samir: FYI ticket #FL-4921 from FourLeaf — they say objects with retention expired are still searchable and downloadable. Dedicated eu-west. No legal hold on their side per initial check. Can someone triage? link: https://support.redwood.ai/t/FL-4921

mae: Can you paste an example object id and a quick repro (curl or UI steps)? Also which storage backend (s3/azure) and KMS key id if available.

samir: object id: obj_8a7f3c9, bucket: fourleaf-prod, storage: s3, kms_key: arn:aws:kms:eu-west:123:key/abcd-ef01. Repro: GET /v1/objects/obj_8a7f3c9 returns 200 and file is downloadable. Metadata shows retention_expires = 2026-11-01T08:12:00Z (past). Audit log snippet: "event: retention_release, actor: system, ts: 1932099000" — but object still present.

ben: checking audit logs now. Quick q: did support or legal apply a temporary hold at any point? Also confirm whether Dedicated uses our KMS proxy or customer-managed key.

samir: customer says no holds on their end. Dedicated uses Redwood-managed KMS proxy for this tenant (we rotate CMKs).

ben: I see an audit event "legal_hold_applied" for tenant fourleaf at 1932098500 then a "legal_hold_removed" at 1932098600. There's also a later event showing deletion queued, but the deletion worker appears to have thrown a retryable error: 
```
ERROR deletion-worker: failed to delete object obj_8a7f3c9, storage error: 5xx S3 DeleteObjects failed
```
Looks like retries didn't clear it and it never backfilled the index removal.

jordan: I'll take on the deletion-worker side. Plan: 1) restart deletion-worker in eu-west 2) re-run reprocess for that object id 3) force reindex removal. ETA ~10-15m. Commands: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/deletion-worker-eu-west` and `infractl reprocess-deletion --object-id=obj_8a7f3c9 --tenant=fourleaf`.

opsbot: Deletion worker restart initiated by jordan.

opsbot: Deployment deletion-worker-eu-west restarted successfully (pod restarted: del-worker-7f9c).

jordan: reprocess job submitted: job id rp-7723. Watching logs now — I see S3 delete succeeded on second attempt and we emitted index_removal event.

mae: I confirmed via the index API that obj_8a7f3c9 is no longer returned by search. Also storage HEAD returns 404. Good.

irene: thanks team. A quick legal check: we need to ensure there was no active, documented legal hold that the customer expects us to honor. Ben, do we have the full legal_hold audit trail?

ben: full trail attached to the ticket — hold was briefly applied by a misrouted script for ~200s, then removed. No active hold at expiry time. We're safe to confirm deletion.

samir: I'll update the customer: explain cause (transient deletion-worker S3 error + retry gap), confirm object removed, offer apology and a 1-week service credit. I'll attach the audit log export and the job run id rp-7723.

mae: follow-up action items: 1) add a backfill worker to pick up deletion_candidates older than 24h 2) add alert for `deletion_queue_retry_count > 5` for > 30m 3) ensure index removal and storage deletion are retried with cross-checks. I'll file infra ticket INFRA-1457.

samir: thanks — customer notified, closing as resolved after customer confirms. :thumbsup:
